new_libraries.name: EmbeddedIoTToolkit
new_libraries.author: CatKod <kimvinhh6@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Portable C99 building blocks for embedded and IoT firmware.
new_libraries.paragraph: It provides non-blocking software timers, an ISR-safe framed serial protocol with XOR checksum, a CAN 2.0B identifier codec, and sensor helpers with stale-data detection. The core has no vendor headers and no dynamic allocation, so it compiles and unit-tests on a PC and drops into STM32, ESP32, or Arduino behind a thin port layer.

new_libraries.name: M5Unit-EncoderMotor-Driver
new_libraries.author: M5Stack
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for M5Stack Unit EncoderMotor (U232) and Unit 4EncoderMotor (U233).
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides one public I2C API for PWM, encoder, speed, position, voltage, current, RGB, and device settings on single-channel and four-channel encoder motor controllers.

library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, sprite, hardware terminal, onboard audio & battery telemetry driver with 1-line autoSetup and adaptive multi-point autoCalibrate for ESP32 CYD resistive & capacitive boards and ESP32-S3 RGB capacitive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive and capacitive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, XPT2046, GT911, CST820) and ESP32-S3 parallel RGB boards (4.3", 5.0", 7.0" 800x480 ST7262 + GT911 capacitive touch). Features ultra-fast AMK_Terminal (5 KB RAM hardware-scrolling text console), onboard PAM8302 audio amplifier enable & pop-free tone generation (tft.enableAudio(), tft.playBeep()), calibrated ADC battery telemetry (tft.getBatteryVoltage(), tft.getBatteryPercentage()), 1-line universal SD card mounting (tft.initSD()), 1-line hardware auto-setup (tft.autoSetup()), adaptive multi-point statistical touch calibration with NVS persistence (tft.autoCalibrate()), ambient light auto-dimming with LDR moving average filtering (tft.adjustBrightness()), universal Active-LOW RGB LED control, persistent NVS hardware overrides, full TFT_eSPI and TFT_eSPI_Button compatibility, linear gradients, alpha blending, TFT_eSprite buffering, LVGL v8/v9 integration, and seamless SquareLine Studio / EEZ Studio support.

library.name: BC7215AC_Universal_Aircon_Control
library.author: Bitcode
library.sentence: Offline universal A/C(Air Conditoner) IR control & IR signal parsing, single step setup and controls any A/C.
library.paragraph: Using BC7215 universal IR decoder/encoder to control any A/C, hundreds of brands, and thouands of models. Nano 33 IoT, ESP8266 and ESP32 examples are provided. This library contains BC7215 basic driver library and A/C control library.

library.name: ESP32IMDB
library.author: Xorlent
library.sentence: Simple in-memory database engine for ESP32
library.paragraph: A lightweight, thread-safe in-memory database with support for integers, floats, strings, MAC addresses, dates, and booleans. Features automatic TTL-based record expiration, memory management, and SPIFFS persistence.
